Entries.SourceTerm: 供養百千諸佛，不如供養一無心道人

Senses.PreferredTarget: Offering to a hundred thousand Buddhas is not as good as offering to one person of no mind.
SearchAliases: Offering to a hundred thousand Buddhas is not as good as offering to one person of no mind
Senses.Note: The comparison makes freedom from grasping the decisive quality of a worthy recipient. No mind does not mean unconsciousness or moral indifference.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師竪起拂子，僧便禮拜。師乃云：古人道：世尊未出母胎，度人已畢。既是未出母胎，因甚度人已畢？老僧道：世尊已出母胎，一人不度。既是已出母胎，因甚一人不度？識得老僧底，便識得古人底。今日香爐頭上三世諸佛、歷代祖師於此轉大法輪，且道是度是不度？良久，云：向下文長。珍重！孫道臺請祈雨，上堂。拈香竟，乃云：今日伏承道臺孫公及合郡尊官、諸春元文學命老僧冒登此座，懇求甘雨。諸仁者！風從何來？雨從何起？電王飛出黑雲頭，問渠畢竟何所止？娑羯羅龍王行雨時，但動一念，娑婆世界雨悉周徧。子細看來，也不離這裏。這裏是甚麼所在？還知麼？拈拄杖，云：老僧柱杖子化為龍，吐霧興雲，遮天掩日，大布滂沱，盡閻浮提悉皆周遍。大眾！且道他承誰恩力？卓拄杖，下座。上堂。論是論非，好似將軍徒罵陣；滅蹤滅影，恰如頑石礙當門。說妙說玄，捕風捉影而徒勞；行棒行喝，帶水拖泥難自脫。到這裏教老僧作麼生開口？良久，云：聽取一偈：寶善菴中日似年，北窓高臥羲皇前，枝頭紅葉無心緒，一任風吹落枕邊。中元日，江海若居士請上堂。今日海若居士為薦先考懷潭封君，命老僧陞座演法。憶昔佛于是日教尊者目連設盂蘭盆，仗十方僧伽之力，其母得出離苦趣，生華光天。又憶佛說：供養百千諸佛，不如供養一無心道人。且作麼生是無心道人？有等便謂：東西不辨，南北不分，隨緣放曠，任性逍遙，何異萬里望鄉關？老僧今日不惜口業，為諸人道破：山如是青，水如是綠，鳥自能飛，魚自能遊。若於此作有佛法見，貶向二鐵圍山；作無佛法見，亦貶向二鐵圍山；不作有無見，祇管隨緣放曠、任性逍遙，亦貶向二鐵圍山。擊拂子，云：二鐵圍山倒了也，無心道人來也。且道作麼生供養？金菓不須猿摘去，玉花何用鳳銜來？上堂。昔韓文公問大顛云：和尚年多少？顛提起數珠云：會麼？公云：不會。顛云：晝夜一百八。這公案，老僧昔在真寂曾拈云：大顛雖是一員老將，怎奈齒不關風？老僧則不然，若有人問：和尚年多少？答云：須彌重九斤。這一轉語却有衲僧氣息。但今老僧年老氣衰，佛法又變了，若有人問：和尚年多少？亦提起數珠云：會麼？彼云：不會。亦云：晝夜一百八。諸人且道：老僧底與大顛底是同？是別？若人識得大顛底，老僧在西牛貸洲打鼓；若人識得老僧底，大顛在東勝神洲作舞。東西雖有異，南北頗相通。珍重。誕日，上堂。老僧今年六十六，寶善菴中借一宿。今朝道是我生辰，大家齊上南山祝。前既不來今不往，兩頭不移中豈續？此中正好悟無生，莫道雙輪如轉軸。假饒壽若須彌盧，我道祇如彈指速。假饒壽若

Senses.Explanation: Offering to a hundred thousand Buddhas is not as good as offering to one person of no mind. The comparison makes freedom from grasping the decisive quality of a worthy recipient. Selected current source uses: Baichi Xingyuan in J28nB202, Tianyin Yuanxiu in J25nB171, Qizhen Cheng in J37nB395. Lingrui poses the line as a live question and supplies his own response. Yongjue applies the line in a present memorial hall address and explains no-mind. The complete wording is the entry unit. No mind does not mean unconsciousness or moral indifference.

Senses.PreferredTarget: Offering to hundreds of thousands of buddhas is less than offering to one person free of grasping.
AlternateTargets: An offering to one uncalculating Wayfarer surpasses offerings to myriad buddhas.

Senses.Note: An unnamed monk asks Luopu why offering to one person without grasping surpasses offerings to many buddhas; Dabian revisits that case during a donor meal. Senses.Explanation: To register for residence and receive an assigned place in a monastery. The Chan Monastic Regulations gives the procedure: a new arrival waits a day or two, presents himself at the hall office with his ordination document, and requests residence. After registration he stores his luggage, hangs his bowl, and arranges his bedding in the unnamed monks' hall. The Imperially Revised Baizhang Monastic Code states the order more compactly: one seeking residence first presents himself at the guest office, then registers at the hall office, after which his assigned place is settled. When the abbot permits registration, the attendant's office notifies the hall office; tea and the bed register follow, and the newcomer enters the common quarters. Encounter narratives use the same institutional verb. Yexian Guixing tells Fushan Fayuan and Tianyi Yihuai, 'You two want to investigate Zen; go register' (你兩箇要參禪，却去掛搭). Fayun Faxiu directs that Ziqing register elsewhere until a place becomes vacant and he can enter the hall (且令別處掛搭，候此間單位空，即令入堂). These sources make the concrete Zen bend visible: registration is not generic lodging but formal admission into the monastery's offices, hall, bed register, and common quarters.

Senses.Explanation: The comparison is a yak so attached to its tail that guarding it becomes the measure of misplaced fixation. Huineng compares laborious fixation on recitation to a yak guarding its tail. Yingshan Zhiyin applies the same comparison to someone who boasts of having discarded teaching but will not seek correction; Yezhu Fuhui uses it against calling an object-pointing exchange transmission of mind.
